answer: Funding-lineage panel exclusion stops a farm from grading its own answers. Each seat's first deposit is traced 4 hops back on the ledger, and seats sharing any ancestor wallet are never drawn onto the same 5-grader jury or allowed to grade each other. Stacking one jury takes 5 seats with disjoint funding, each paid in from a separate outside source, so every extra fake needs its own fresh bankroll; relaying coins through new wallets fails, since each hop is on the ledger too. Honest seats work as before, whether they price marble, date ember samples or plan a satellite's nadir pass.
